summary: Draganfly Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on NASDAQ and the CSE, furnished a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent of a foreign issuer current report) attaching its November 10, 2026 press release announcing third-quarter 2026 results. Revenue was $2,048,425, down 5.0% year over year; gross margin fell to 6.3% from 19.5%, with a $366,609 non-cash inventory write-down; comprehensive loss was $13,032,744; cash was $128,605,465 at September 30, 2026. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor or deal terms were disclosed; watch execution on defence procurement and cash burn.
